description: This file defines the Subscription class controller for the OpenCart admin extension report, handling subscription-related report functionalities including viewing, listing, and saving subscription configurations.

classes.name: Subscription
classes.description: Controller class responsible for managing subscription reports in the OpenCart admin extension.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads the subscription report form view, initializing necessary data and breadcrumbs.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes and saves the subscription report settings based on submitted form data.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Displays the subscription report page with report data.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Outputs the list of subscription reports.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Retrieves and formats the subscription report data based on filters.
